name: Persist supervisor Board changes promptly
description:
Factory review recommendation 5 of 20.

## Context

Interval Git commits in short CLI calls can leave Board changes unavailable to workers that synchronize through origin/main; startup cleanup may also misclassify pending Rowbly data.

## Acceptance criteria

- Configure the supervisor to commit Board changes promptly and define when it pushes them for worker synchronization.
- Handle pending Rowbly data through the Git Plugin before the generic cleanup-PR path.
- Preserve unrelated changes and update ROWBLY.md and the factory startup instructions consistently.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.body: Supervisor plan review: Plan accepted with corrections. Confirmed thinkpad Git show now returns automaticCommits:true, frequency:"change", synchronization:{enabled:true,intervalSeconds:300}. Treat explicit Board workflow instructions as the authority for changing personal Git preferences; here ROWBLY.md requires each-change commits. When the Git Plugin is enabled, use its documented manual `git sync` path for pending Rowbly data and rejected pushes; do not gate manual sync on a nonexistent/old Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution flag or claim it never rebases internally. Say never run raw rebase/force-push yourself. Verify sync preserves unrelated staged/working content and handles saved pending Rowbly data before generic cleanup; don't infer arbitrary hand edits are tracked. Keep edits to startup/persistence sections only (ROW-54 launch; ROW-63 retry; ROW-53 later brief generation). ROWBLY.md exact diff remains proposal-only. Capture one agentic-tui terminal PNG of pertinent command output/guidance to meet invoked skill evidence requirement; all four checks required. Proceed.
